tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba bzhugs so/ /

shog ser/ mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku tshe snga mar zab gter gdan drangs nas/ /da lta nyams len longs sku'i zhing khams nyul/ /ma 'ongs bum thang mdzad pa mthar phyin nas/ /mngon par byang chub de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'das pa'i dus na rgyal sras padma gsal/ /ma 'ongs gu ru dri med 'od zer te/ /da ltar kun mkhyen tshul khrims bzang po' ི blo/ /zab mo'i thugs gter phrin las rgyas mdzad cing*/ /'gro don dpag med mdzad pa lhun grub ces/ /mkha' 'gros lung bstan rnam thar mdo tsam bri/ /legs pa'i yon tan rmad du byung bas rab tu brgyan pa'i bla ma dam pa 'di ni sku tshe snga ma'i rabs dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas rang byung padma rgyal pos rjes su bzung zhing*/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i 'od zer mtha' yas pas gdul bya'i padma 'dzum pa la mkhas shing*/ mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i lam po che'i srol btod pa la snying rje chen po'i shing rtas 'gro ba rnams 'dren zhing*/ rnam par grol ba'i skyed mo'i tshal shin tu nyams dga' bar thar pa chen po'i dus ston la 'god par mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa mtha' yas pa las/ 'dir cung zad cig mchims phu rin po che zhi ba sgrub pa'i nags khrod du dpal rdo rje phag mos ji skad gsungs pa bzhin brjod par bya'o/ / de'ang dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog tu chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas spyan drangs nas gtsug lag khang bzhengs su gsol te/ rab gnas chung ngu'i tshe mchims phur gshegs nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i dus su/ btsun mo 'bro bza' byang chub la 'khrungs pa'i sras mo padma gsal zhes bya ba/ lo brgyad lon pa zhig 'das pas/ rgyal pos mya ngan mdzad pa na/ slob dpon gyis chos bstan pas/

de'i tshe rgyal pos gser gzhong rin po ches bkang ba phul nas/ nga'i gtsug lag khang dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji tsam gnas/ bu mo 'di'i chos skal gang lags la sogs pa zhus pas lan rgyas par gsungs ta ེ/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyis rnam shes bkug pas bu mo slar sos te slob dpon dang yab yum sras kun mjal dus dbang bskur te/ gsang mtshan padma las 'brel rtsal du btags/ tshe lo lnga bcu kha ral na zab gter gyis sems can mang po la phan 'dogs shing gu ru dri med 'od zer du lung bstan dus bu mos mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dpe sgrom spyi bor bzhag nas smon lam btab bo/ /de nas skye ba mang zhig gnas/ gsal rje gangs kyi shar phyogs su/ spa sgang pa rin chen rdo rje zhes par skyes nas/ dwags po dngas lung khra mo brag nas zab gter gdan drangs te/ ring por ma lon par sku gshegs so/ /chu mo glang nas deng song shing mo yos kyi bar lo sum cu so drug zab gter thon nas song la/ lo bzhir ni gter ston nyid kyis mchod par mdzad cing*/ lhag par gter chos rnams phyogs kun tu 'thor zhing rgyas so/ /de nas rin chen rdo rje nyid kyi zhus lan gser phreng las/ dar cig longs sku'i zhing khams nyul te bum thang thar pa gling du skye ba bzhes par gsungs pa bzhin du/ longs sku'i zhing nyul ba'i phyir g.yo ru grwa zhes bya ba'i phu stod grong dben rtsa zhes bya bar/ yab slob dpon bstan pa bsrung ba dang / yum 'gro bza' mo bsod nams rgyan gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs te/ lo bdun la yi ge'i 'bri klog dang*/ brgyad dang dgu la phur pa dang bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs phrin las dang bcas pa mkhyen dus yum 'das so/ /bcu la gu ru'i chos gter sna bo lugs kyi skor phrin las dang bcas pa dang / bcu gcig la rgya nag po'i rtsis la thugs sbyong dus yab 'das so/ /dgung lo bcu gsum pa la bsam yas su mkhan po bsam 'grub rin che

na dang*/ slob dpon kun dga' 'od zer las rab du byung ste 'dul ba la sbyangs pas/ dgung lo bco lnga la gsung stai lo gsum bskyangs so/ /de'i bar du 'dul ba'i las phran (< a > lung bran ) rnams dang*/ theg pa che chung gi chos rnams la lung nod mdzad do/ /bcu dgu la dpal gsang phu ne'u thog tu byon te/ slob dpon chen po bla brang pa chos dpal rgyal mtshan dang*/ gzhon nu rin chen la sogs pa las mtshan nyid kyi theg pa rnams gsan cing*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ rgyud bla ma la sogs pa mkhyen par mdzad de/ lo gsum du phyi nang gi chos rnams la thugs sbyong dang lung nod mang po mdzad do/ /de'i dus su slob dpon gzhon nu rgyal po la sogs pa las dbu ma tshig gsal dang 'jug pa la sogs pa gsan nas mkhyen par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang lung dang*/ rig pa dang*/ sgrub sde du ma'i gzhung lugs mang po gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la bla ma bkra shis rin chen la sogs pa las dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dang*/ kyai rdo rje la sogs pa gsang sngags gsar ma'i dbang khrid gdams pa dang bcas du ma la thugs sbyangs so/ /de'i dus su khyad par du lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ lam rim pa lnga pa/ nā ro dang ni gu'i chos drug /rdzogs chen sems phyogs/ sgyu 'phrul zhi khro/ gcod yul zhi byed la sogs pa la thugs sbyong mdzad do/ nyi shu rtsa bdun pa la dpal ldan chos kyi rje ku ma rā dza dang mjal te/ rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying tig gi dbang khrid gdams pa dang bcas pa thob cing*/ phyis de lo dbang gong ma rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa'i gtad rgya babs te/ lo gsum gyi bar sgrub pa mdzad do/ /sum cu rtsa gcig pa la mthar 'byon par bzhed nas snyi phu shugs gseb tu lam 'gron pa gzigs su byon dus/ skal ldan gyi slob ma du mas gsol ba btab nas/ rdzogs pa chen po snying tig gi khrid mdzad dus su/

rnal 'byor pa 'od zer go chas lo ro nas dka' spyad chen pos zhus pa'i mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dpe yongs su tshang ba bla ma la gzigs su phul dus/ gzim lam du srog sgrub mas phyag dpe gtad pa rmis so/ /de nas sang phod sum cu rtsa gnyis pa shing mo yos kyi lo dpyid zla 'bring po la mchims phu ri mo can gyi nags su skal ldan gyi rnal 'byor pho mo brgyad la rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying tig gi gdams pa btsugs te spros med kyi dbang mdzad dus byin phab pas/ dpal sngags srung chen mo rnal 'byor ma zhig la babs nas 'khrab pa la/ thams cad the tshom du gyur dus bla ma'i gsung gis 'dir mkha' 'gro dngos su babs pa yin pas a'u tsi/ nga snang sems ro gcig tu rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin pas bar chad mi 'ong gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma la rnal 'byor mas phyag 'tshal te/ mchod gtor rnams la bltas nas rma bya ma 'dzom pa la ga re gsungs dus/ yid kyis mos pa byed pa yin mod gsungs pas/ brda'i chos la yid kyis gar 'ong 'di mi dgos gsungs nas bum pa steng gi mañdzi la nas gzhong dang bcas pa bor te bum pa gsum 'brel bar bzhag go /bla mas cho ga'i rnam bshad zhib mor mdzad dus thal mo sbyar te legs so gsungs shing dbu khugs pa re'ang mdzad do/ /rigs dang zhes pa'i yi ge'i sa chad pas/ min min rigs zer ba yin gsungs so/ āoṃ la sogs pa'i yi ge bzlas dus nga'i lad mo gyis zer nas mkha' 'gro'i skad du sngags rnams 'brel la ma 'dres pa'i gdangs snyan po byung ngo*/ /dngos gzhi'i tshig brgyad kyi skabs su bsgom du med pa'i chad pa'ang gsos te/ blo sgom dang bral na dga' ba la/ sgom blo dang bral na a re skya ི da/ zer zhing glu blangs so/ /mchod pa ngan pa la'ang 'dis mi 'ongs gsungs shing mchod dbyangs snyan po'ang mdzad de/ tshogs kyi dus su bla ma la bdud rtsi gsol zhal che ba bkang nas drangs dus/

'di mkha' 'gro'i dam rdzas yin pas cis kyang brten dgos gsungs nas lhag ma ma lus par drangs so/ de dus rnal 'byor pa rin chen 'od 'phros/ dpal mgon po mthing nag rgyan cha rdzogs pa'ang mthong ngo*/ /de nas nam langs kyi bar mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs khyad par can byung ngo*/ /de nas khrid ma thon gyi bar la rnal 'byor pho mo thams cad nyams 'ur te glu len bro brdungs/ nyin mtshan thams cad du shes pa bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams 'bar zhing*/ gnyid song ba'i rmi lam med/ ma song ba'i sad rgyu byung ngo*/ /de dus nyi shu bzhi la rnal 'byor pa 'od zer go cha yang gcig pu gser zho do'i maṇḍal dang bcas pa bla ma'i drung du phyin nas phul lo/ /de nub rnal 'byor ma gzhan zhig gis bla ma'i drung du skyes pa lo brgyad lon pa phod ka smug nag can rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gsol zhing bhandha dang phur pa thogs pa mkha' 'gro bzhis bskor ba mthong ngo*/ /nyi shu lnga'i nyi ma phyed yol na rnal 'byor mas nam mkha'i dkyil na ye shes mgon po mkha' 'gro lngas bskor ba byaun pa mthong ngo*/ /de dus nam mkha' thams cad mkha' 'gros gang bar snang ngo*/ nyi ma nub mtshams su rnal 'byor pa 'od zer mtha' yas kyis gzim chung na bud med lo bco lnga tsam lon pa dkar dmar mthing gsum rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'ang mthong ngo*/ /yang sngags pa bro brdungs pa dang*/ bud med rgyan chas bklubs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ khyad par du bud med skra'i lan tshar rting par slebs pa gzugs shin tu ring ba gcig bla ye na 'dug pa dang*/ chos ra na skyes pa dkar sangs pa rgyan can lnga bro brdungs pa la 'khor dpag tu med pas sa dang bar snang gang bar mthong ngo*/ /byis pa se ral can gsum yang rdzu 'phrul ston pa dang*/ bud med dkar mo gser g.yu dar zab kyis brgyan pa zha ི ga gis bla ma'i dbu thog na rma bya'i gdugs chen po 'dzin pa mthong ngo*/

/de nub tshogs 'khor gyi dus su bud med nag mo gcig gis kyang de bzhin du gdugs 'dzin pa mthong ngo*/ /nyin mtshan du rgyal mtshan sna tshogs pa 'dzin mkhan med par rong nger yod pa'i dar gyi 'phan ldir phyar re mthong ngo*/ / de'i nyi ma nub khar rnal 'byor ma zhig gi dngos snang du/ skyes pa ber smug dang rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can mkha' 'gro ma'i 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba bla ye dang bar snang khengs pa la/ mun sros dus dbang khang du 'gro ba mthong nas rnal 'byor mas gar byas so/ /yang rnal 'byor ma zhig gis mi nag po chen po gcig dang*/ sngags pa mthing nag mkha' 'gro sde lngas bskor ba glu len pa mang po nam mkha' nas dbang khang du byon pa mthong nas tshogs gtor bshams zer dus/ bla mas gzim chung nas tshogs gtor shoms shig gsungs te bshams pas bud med nag mo gcig phye phud nyams zer ba dang*/ mi dkar po zhig nga'i gtor ma na sha mi 'dug zer ba la bltas pas dam can gyi gtor ma na sha chad pa slar gsos so/ /dar cig na rta dkar mi dkar can gcig gtor ma 'dod pa la dmar gtor byin pa mi len par song ba jo bo ldang lhar snang ngo*/ /bla ma khri la bzhugs dus sa gzhi bar snang mkha' 'gros gang ba kun phyag 'tshal zhing mos pa byed cing*/ tshogs gtor gyi mgron rnams thams cad nam mkhar byon pa la tshogs gtor bsngos nas dar cig na srod phyed la rnal 'byor pho mo thams cad kyis thos pa mkha' 'gro'i hūṃ sgra dang*/ phaṭa sgra dang*/ bso sgra dang*/ 'ur sgra dang*/ sil chom mang po byung zhing*/ glo bur du bag dro 'ur 'ur lus tsha chil chil shes pa skyi zing zing bun bun phyod phyod byung bas/ rnal 'byor pa zhig na re do nub gnam sa ling logs pa sha dum khrag dum byed las che zer nas skrag go /dar cig na yang rnal 'byor ma zhig gis sa gzhi bar snang thams cad mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung 'thibs te cha

ི li li 'byon pa mthong nas tshogs gtor bsngos so/ /de nas dar cig na rnal 'byor ma ral pa sprugs shing 'dug dus rdo rje phag mo sku mdog mthing nag cig gis nam mkha' khengs pa thim pa snyam byed nas 'khrabs so/ /yong bar yod yong bar yod gsungs pa la/ ci yongs dris pas/ sang gnang la bar chad yong bar yod/ min na yar 'gro na mang po yod gsungs pa la/ su byung dris pas/ sman mo mched bdun dkar la gzhon sha chags pa za 'og gi na bza' can gser g.yu rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa 'khor sman mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba byung*/ da dung 'byung ngo*/ /'o de gung rgyal mi nag rta nag can ber nag mdung nag can ral pa g.yas g.yon du 'khyil ba'i la thod yod pa 'khor yang de 'dra ba mang pos bskor ba byung ngo*/ /da dung 'byung ngo*/ gnyan chen thang lha rta dkar mi dkar can 'khor yang de 'dra ba du mas bskor ba 'dug go gtor ma byin cig gsungs pa la/ gtor ma yang phul lo/ /rnal 'byor ma'i zhal nas/ nga gsar du 'ongs pa la gtor ma/ m-i ster ba e yin gsung dus/ su yin dris pas/ nga snga ma'i yi dam rdo rje phag mo yin zer dus/ rnal 'byor pa 'od zer mtha' yas kyis bud med mthing nag gzhan pas che ba rus pas brgyan pa rin po che dang rus pa'i dra bas brgyan par mthong nas/ khyed rnams kyis 'di cir mthong zer nas bshad do/ /de nas bla mas dris pa/ khyed 'dir ci la byon/ bla ma dam pa sku khams bzang ngam/ rnal 'byor mas smras pa/ do nub dus gnyan pas las can gyi slob ma nyul du 'ong*/ bla ma sku khams bzang zer ro/ 'o na da lo bla ma sku chag che ba a'u tsi 'am dris pas sangs rgyas kyi rnal 'phrul la bar chad ga na yod/ gdul bya la dgongs pa yin mod/ bi ma la bod yul du byon pa mi shes sam gsungs/ 'o na ji tsam bzhugs/ da nas lug lo phyi ma'i bar bzhugs/ de nas gdul bya dang bstun pas nges pa med/

'o na nga bla mas gzhan don la bskul de khyed kyis bskul ba lags sam dris pas/ 'o 'o de ka de ka zer dus/ ngas gcig pur bsdad nas/ 'od lus bsgrub bam/ gzhan don byas na sems can la phan thogs yong*/ /da ji tsam thub dris pas/ 'od lus 'grub kyang sems can la phan 'dogs dgos/ gzhan don 'ur 'ur/ da lo nas bzung ste lo sum cu thub gsungs so/ /de dus rnal 'byor pa 'od zer go cha na re sku tshe ring bar 'dug zhus pas/ bla ma'i zha la nas mkha' 'gro'i 'di la gzab gtad med/ zla ba dang*/ zhag la lor brtsi ba'ang srid pas gang yin mi shes gsungs so/ /yang bla mas nga la bka' srung ji tsam yod dris pas/ mang mang bla ma'i thams cad khyed la yod/ khyad par du rdo rje g.yu sgron ma yin zer ro/ /'gro don sa phyogs ga na yod dris pas/ lho nub phyogs na yod/ de yang gra dang grwa phyi dang 'phreng po phyogs na yod/ 'o na ngas gzhan la phan nges sam dris pas/ da nas bzung nas 'ur 'ur/ tshe phyi ma de bas kyang 'gro don rgya che gsungs/ phyi ma ga na yod dris pas/ lho brag phyogs dang*/ mon bod rgya gar gyi mtshams na rgya che rgya che gsungs/ mon bum thang yin nam dris pas/ 'o 'o de ka de ka ma nor ma nor gsungs so/ /'o na mkha' 'gro snying tig nas ji skad bshad pa'i dbang khrid da lta gdab tu rung ngam dris pas/ khyed rang gi yin pa la los los zer ro/ /mi rnams kyis zog por 'dzin du mi yong ngam dris pas/ mi'i kha la rgyu mtshan ci yod/ skal ldan rnams nged kyis sdud skal med smra mkhan med kyang mi 'du/ sangs rgyas la'ang skur pa 'debs pa zer ro/ /'o na snying tig gi chos bka' gang du 'byed rdo rje g.yu sgron gyis gnas su 'byed dam dris pas/ 'di na mkha' 'gro rang bzhin gyis 'du bas 'dir 'byed dgos zer ro/ / bum thang gi gter kha de tshe 'di la thon nam dris pas/ dam tshig shin tu gtsang ba'i slob ma gsum bzhi tsam yod na thon zer ro/

/da lta yod dam dris pas/ med sngags pa dkar sangs sha ni bsrab la shin tu mdzes pa zhig 'ong*/ de dus thon zer ro/ /gter yig dris pas/ de dus lung ston mkhan re yong dri mi dgos gsungs so/ /gter sa'i brag dris pas/ bum thang gi gzhung chu lho nub la babs pa'i lung pa zad du nye ba'i shar ngos kyi brag mtha' pi wang gyen du bslangs pa lta bu'i mgo phyir gyed la song ba'i mgul mtshams na tshur 'ongs pa'i gad mchu'i steng na shing lo stag ma ltar yod pa nas thag pa btags nas 'doms bcu gnyis song ba na brag gru bzhi zo thabs su yod pa'i dkyil smad ser ka gru gsum yod pa na 'dug zer ro/ /nga dang slob dpon chen po nam mjal dris pas/ lung gsum gyi phu ri gsum gyi mda' brag chung nge ba kha lho nub tu lta ba brag gsum pa de'i g.yas zur gyi 'og tu mjal nas lung ston gsungs so/ /bi ma la dang nam mjal dris pas/ mjal zin 'dug pa la zer ro/ /ngas rtogs pa 'di snying tig gi don mthar thug pa yin nam dris pas/ mthar thug go zer ro/ /gter kha gzhan dris pas 'di nas nub byang mtshams na brag ri shin tu mtho ba mdung rtse gyen du gzengs pa 'dra ba'i ngos nas thon te der mi bzhud gsungs so/ /'o na shar phyogs khra mo brag gi gter kha de ngas thon nam mi thon dris pas/ thon zin 'dug pa zer ro/ /rnal 'byor pa 'od zer go chas spa sgang pa rin chen rdo rje de ga na yod dris pas/ spa sgang pa rin chen rdo rje zhes dar cig mi gsal ba las/ slob dpon rin rdor dris pas/ lags lags so de khong yin 'di na bzhugs 'dug pa gsungs nas mdzub mo btsugs so/ /bla mas dris pa/ khong skye ba de'i 'og tu bum thang du skye bar gsungs pa la dag na yin gsungs pas/ skyai ba de'i 'og tu longs sku'i zhing dar cig nyul nas bum thang du skye ba las de ka ltar skye ba min/ da lta khyed rang longs sku'i zhing nyul ba yin zer ro/

/da lta longs sku'i zhing nyul ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin dris pas/ slob dpon rin rdor gyis gter thon dus lo 'gar gsang nas sgrub pa mdzad na rang don du 'od gsal longs sku'i zhing nyul gyis rtsal sbyong dang snying tig gi gzhan la phan 'dogs 'ongs pa la/ ma gsung pas sku tshe tshad du ma phyin par da lta skyes dus 'od gsal 'ja' tshon gyi snang ba sgom zhing nyams su len pa la longs sku'i zhing dar cig nyul bar btags pa yin/ de gzhan gyis dgongs pa len ma shes pa yin/ lung bstan pa gsungs pa de da lta'i tshe 'di la dgongs pa lags zer ro/ /ngas lhag med gar 'grub dris pas/ gcig pur bsgoms na da lta 'grub/ /gzhan don mdzad pas bar dor grol nas sprul pas bum thang du skye ba blangs te/ rdzu 'phrul mang po bstan/ gzhan don byas nas sprul pa de yang mkha' 'gro ma lngas bskor nas ma ga ta rdo rje gdan gyi nub byang o rgyan gyi yul du gshegs nas 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston gsungs so/ /slob dpon rin rdor gang la grongs lo du song dris pas/ keg la grongs lo sum cu so gnyis song gsungs so/ /ngas snying tig gang gis phan thogs/ bi ma la'i snying tig dang mkha' 'gro snying tig lo du gnas dris pas/ gnyis kas phan thogs bi ma la rgya che/ bi ma la lo brgya/ mkha' 'gro snying tig lo lnga brgyar gnas/ da lo nas mgo brtsams pa yin zer ro/ /de dus rnal 'byor pho mo rnams kyi tshe dang phan 'dogs kyang lung bstan nas/ dar cig na rnal 'byor pa 'od zer mtha' yas kyi snang ba la nam mkha'i dkyil nas/ bud med dkar mo za 'og gi na bza' dang dar thod can gser g.yus brgyan pa zhig byung nas bla ma la thim pa mthong dus/ bla ma bzhengs te ngas sngar mi shes pa'i rdo rje'i glu zhig bya'o gsungs mgur bzhengs pa/ lhun grub gdod nas stong pa ka dag dang*/ /bde gshegs kun bzang yab yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/sems nyid spros dang bral ba chos nyid dang*/ /gti mug rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rnam snang nang na yod de phyi na med/ /bde gshegs sangs rgyas rigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /skye med bsam yul 'das pa'i gnas lugs nyid/ /rang shar rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /rig rtsal 'char gzhi ma 'gags me long dang*/ /zhe sdang rang sar grol ba'i ngo bo nyid//mi bskyod nang na yod de phyi na med/ /bde gshegs rdo rje'i rigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gyu ba stong gsal 'dzin med gnas lugs nyid//rang shar rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /blang dor dgag sgrub med pa mnyam nyid dang*/ /nga rgyal rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rin 'byung nang na yod de phyi na med/ /bde gshegs rin chen rigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /thams cad phyam brdal gnas lugs mnyam pa nyid/ /rang shar rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /bde stong dbyings su nub pa kun rtog dang*/ /'dod chags rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /'od dpag nang na yod de phyi na med//bde gshegs padma'i rigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde stong gzung 'dzin nub pa'i gnas lugs nyid/ /rang shar rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /rig pa thal byung rang grol bya grub dang*/ /phrag dog rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /don grub nang na yod de phyi na med/ /bde gshegs las kyi rigs la gsol ba 'debs/ gang shar shugs 'byung 'gags med gnas lugs nyid/ /rang shar rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus do nub mar gyi tshes bcu la/ /mkha' 'gros lung bstan mdzad pa'i dus/ /rten 'brel nang du 'dzom pa'i rtags/ /dad ldan dam tshig gtsang ba'i rtags/ / 'gro don phyogs med 'byung ba'i rtags/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor brgal ba'i rtags//dga' 'o skyid do dag pa'i zhing*/ /'od gsal snod kyi 'jig rten 'di/ /'og min gnas su slebs pa bzhin/ /thams cad lha dang lha mo'i ngang*/ /rang rig mya ngan 'das pa snyam/

blang dor dgag sgrub zhig pa snyam/ re dogs 'phrang las 'das pa snyam/ /srid gsum ye nas grol ba snyam//'phro 'du'i rnam rtog 'od lngar nub/ /'od lnga'i snang ba gdod mar nub/ /snang sems gzhi bral chos sku'i ngang*/ /tshe 'di yang bde stai phyi ma bde/ /bar dor rang ngo shes pas bde/ /da ni bde nas bde bar 'gro /glu mchod par 'bul lo dkon mchog gsum/ /thugs dgyes par mdzod cig mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /zhes bro brdungs nas dar cig na gnam sgo na yar bud med dmar mo rin po che'i brgyan pa zhig res gsum du snang ba 'gas mthong ba la bsu ba byas pa dang*/ bla ma la thim mo/ /dkar mo gcig kyang de bzhin du byon nas thim dus/ sa gzhi bar snang thams cad mkha' 'gros gang bar mthong ngo*/ /de'i dus bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku phod ka smug nag dang rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gsol nas rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa dkar gsal 'od lnga'i dbus na bzhugs pa la/ res dkar dmar mthing gsum mthong nas rnal 'byor mas cod paṇa btags te bdud rtsi drangs dus/ thams cad la gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag nas lung bstan pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i snang ba byung tshul rnams su la'ang mi bshad pa'i mna' bsgags nas dar cig na/ bud med mthing nag rgyan gyis brgyan pa cig la de 'dra ba dpag tu med pas bskor ba nam mkha' na tshur byon nas bla ma'i sku la thim pa rnal 'byor ma 'gas mthong ngo*/ /de nas nam langs su nye ba na thams cad na re nam langs su nye mkha' 'gro yang gyes las che zer ba la/ rnal 'byor ma sngo sangs zhig nyams 'ur nas 'khrab pas/ mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'thibs pa 'di/ /drin can bla ma'i grub rtags yin/ /chos skyong bla ma bran ltar khol ba 'di/ /drin can bla ma'i phrin las yin/ /'gro drug bu bzhin skyong pa 'di/ /drin can bla ma'i thugs rje yin/ /nyam chung mtho ris 'dren pa 'di/ /drin can bla ma'i byang sems yin/

/ci yod chos phyogs gtong ba 'di/ drin can bla ma'i rnam thar yin/ /zer ro/ /de nas nyi shu drug gi dro khar rnal 'byor ma bla yer nyal dus/ skyes pa lo bco brgyad lon pa phod ka can dang*/ bu mo lo bcu drug ma shin tu mdzes pa zhig dang*/ mkha' 'gro mang po bar snang la 'cham po mdzad pa mthong nas/ chos gsungs te de rnams nyan cing bla ma longs sku'i cha lugs su mthong ngo*/ /mtshan dus rnal 'byor ma 'ga' gzim chung yod dus/ bud med skra'i gos can ral pas gnam sa khebs pa rin po che'i brgyan pa zhig dang*/ /sngags pa dkar po zhig dang*/ bka' srung gi rigs mon pa dang*/ a tsa ra'i rnam pa mang po gtor ma len du byon dus/ rnal 'byor pa 'od zer mtha' yas bred de 'di na tshur byung ngo zer ro/ /de nas sang nyi shu bdun khrid 'chad dus/ sngar gyi slob ma dam tshig nyams pa zhig byung bas/ grib kyis thams cad skad 'gags rig pa mig gsal te sang gnang bar chad 'od zer ba de yin par snang ngo*/ /do nub srod la bla ma'i drung du bu mo lo bcu drug lon pa dar zab can gnyis bdud rtsi gsol zhal bkang ba 'dren pa 'od zer mtha' yas kyis mthong ngo*/

/ mkha' 'gro mang pos phyag dang bskor ba yang byed do/ /de dus rnal 'byor ma dkar sangs zhig gis gzim chung du bud med gnyis song ba mthong ngo*/ /de'i tho rangs rnal 'byor pho mo thams cad kyis skad ma thon par bla ma la zhus pas/ na rag gi skong bshags mdzad pas/ 'phral la nam mkha' dwangs shing grib sangs te/ bla ma'i nam mkha' la padma'i sdong po la paṇḍi ta lnga tsam res snang res mi snang zhing*/ 'dab ma la byis pa'i gzugs phra mos brgyan pa mthong nas dga' ston mdzad do/ /de nyin nyi shu rtsa brgyad la chos gsung dus lho nub nas slob dpon padma dkar gsal za 'og gi ber dang sha ba'i mnyen zhu can mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba byon nas bla ma la thim pa rnal 'byor ma gsum tsam gyis mthong ngo*/ /de nub srod la rnal 'byor pa 'od zer mtha' yas kyis khong rang bla ma'i drung na gcer bu rus pa dang rin po che'i brgyan nas bla ma'i steng gi nam mkha' la bun bun 'gro bas mchod pa byed par mthong ngo*/ /de dus nam mkha'i dkyil na tshur bud med smug nag gsum 'khrab cing*/ /nga yong yong bde chen gyi gnas nas yong*/ /las can gyi slob ma nyul du yong*/ /dam tshig gi gtsang sbra lta ru yong*/ /'gro don mdzod cig rigs kyi bu/ /zer ba bla ma dang rnal 'byor pho mo lnga drug tsam gyis mthong zhing*/ bla ma yang longs skur snang ngo*/ /yang nyi shu dgu'i snga dro rnal 'byor ma zhig na re chang bsing ran/ mkha' 'gro mang po 'dus nas 'dug zer ro/ /de nub lung bstan pa'i dga' ston byed pas tshogs gtor shoms shig gsungs pas/ ji ltar bsham zhus pas/ bla mas dbus su dpal yon tan tham cad rgyas par byed pa'i dpal gtor chen po gcig /shar du rdo rje phag mo srog sgrub gnyis la dpal gtor re/ rdo rje g.yu sgron la sman leb gcig /dmar nag gi gza' bshos phyed tel can gcig /lha rabs mched dgu'i zlum gtor gcig

/bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi sman leb gcig dang dpal gtor gnyis/ ldang lha'i btsan bshos gcig /byang gi mgor sngags srung gi dpal gtor gcig /mkha' 'gro spyi'i zlum gtor gcig /gza' bdud kyi bshos bu dgu bskor cig /dam can gyi bshos bu mkhar thabs cig pe dkar gyi gsang bsang phyi gcig /nub tu re ma ti mched lnga'i dpal gtor re/ gzhi bdag gi dkar gtor gcig / lhor legs ldan/ gdong bzhi pa/ mi thung*/ bya rog ma seng ge'i gdong can rnams kyi dpal gtor re'i mthar mgron glo bur pa'i zlum gtor gcig / pha tshad du bgegs gtor gcig rnams shoms shig gsungs so/ /de dus bsangs chu ma bran pa dang*/ sha brjed pa dang*/ bdud rtsi brjed pa rnams la/ nga'i der ma byung zer dus bltas pas mi 'dug nas gsos so/ /bdud rtsi'i mchod pa'i skabs su mdun gyi nam mkha'i pad sdong las slob dpon padma za 'og gi 'jol ber sha ba'i gnyen zhu can/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i g.yas su bi ma la dkar po paṇḍi ta'i cha byad g.yas po ti thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag can/ mkhur tshos gnyis rgya skegs kyis byugs pa 'dra ba dang*/ mdun na mkha' 'gro mang pos mi rkang gi gling bu 'bud cing*/ g.yon du rdo rje phag mo'i sku gcig gis nam mkha' gang ba mkha' 'gro'i cha byad can dang*/ rgyab na tshur sngags pa mang po 'chams shing*/ mkha' 'gro gser gyi go shubs can glu gar byed pa mang pos bskor nas bzhugs pa/ rnal 'byor ma zhig gis mthong dus de dag gis bla ma la dbang bskur nas thim pa dang*/ bla mas bzhengs te ngas rd+wo rje'i glu sngar mi shes pa zh-ig blang ngo gsungs nas bzhengs pa/ dga' 'o skyid do rnal 'byor kun/ /dus do nub 'og min dag pa'i zhing*/ /rang lus lha yi pho brang na/ /stong gsal zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /sangs rgyas phyi na med de nang na yod/ /dus do nub bde chen gyi nyi zla shar/

/ma rig gi mun pa sangs snying 'dod/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skam snying 'dod/ /bdag 'dzin gyi sprin tshogs dengs pa yin/ /chos brgyad kyi mkhar spe zhig pa yin/ /re dogs kyi 'phrang las 'das pa yin/ / 'di dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /bla ma phyi na med de nang na yod/ / ka dag lhun grub kyi bla ma de/ /gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang la bzhugs/ / 'char sgor sna tshogs kyi maṇḍal 'bul/ /rtog med rang mdangs kyi yon chab 'bul/ /rang gsal 'dzin med kyi me tog 'bul/ /rang grol chig chod kyi bdug spos 'bul/ /nyin mtshan kha sbyor snang gsal 'bul/ /'dzin med rang shar gyi dri chab 'bul/ /dga' bde lhun grub kyi zhal zas 'bul/ / grags stong skye med kyi sil snyan 'bul/ /phyi sna tshogs yul gyi mchod pa rnams/ /shar grol 'dzin med kyi ngang nas 'bul/ /nang 'byung bzhi lus kyi gtor gzhong du/ /tsitta zur brgyad kyi gtor ma la/ /dpa' bo rnam lnga'i gtor rgyan btsugs/ /dwangs ma chen po'i bdud rtsis bran/ /bde gsal 'dzin med kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /gsang ba kun gzhi'i bhandha ru/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi sman rag blugs/ /'gyu ba sems kyi dri bsung can/ /ngo bo stong gsal gyi bdud rtsi 'di/ /shar grol dus mnyam gyi skyes bu yis/ /gzhi rdzogs gdod ma'i lha la 'bul/ /sems dag ye shes kyi nam mkha' la/ mngon sum 'od gsal gyi nyi zla shar/ nyams snang gong 'phel gyi zer gdangs 'phro/ /rig pa tshad phebs kyi dkyil 'khor gang*/ /chos dbyings zad pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /lhun grub 'od gsal gyi zhing khams de/ /ka dag chos zad kyi ngang du thim/ /thim la ma rmugs bum pa'i sku/ /gsal ba 'dzin med rig pa'i gdangs/ /g.yo med chos sku'i ngang la bzhugs/ /gang la gang 'dul gyi 'gro don mdzad/ /'di bya rtsol med pa'i 'bras bu yin/ / dga' 'o skya ི da do rdo rje spun/ /tshe 'di yang bde ste phyi ma bde/

/bar do rang ngo shes pas bde/ /lus mi 'gyur ri bo'i dgon pa na/ /sems gcig pur gnas pa'i bsam gtan la/ /yid gcig la ma 'dzin gang bder thong*/ / sems 'phro yang stong la gnas kyang stong*/ /gang shar ye shes kyi rol pa yin/ /'di gnyis 'dzin zad na los kyang yin/ /skye med rnam dag gi sems nyid de/ /chos dbyings ye shes kyi rig gdangs yin/ /gnas kyang mi lto gang bder zhog /bsam mno dgag sgrub kyi 'char gzhi de/ /me long ye shes kyi rigs gdangs yin/ /sems 'phro yang mi lto gang bder thong*/ /sems gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang gcig pa/ /mnyam nyid ye shes kyi rig gdangs yin/ /sems gnas kyang mi lto gang bder zhog /sems yul la dga' ba'i 'dod chags can/ /kun rtog ye shes kyi rig gdangs yin/ /sems chags kyang mi lto rang ngo ltos/ /sems dgag sgrub thol byung gi rig pa de/ /bya grub ye shes kyi rig gdangs yin/ /sems 'gyus kyang mi lto gang bder thong*/ / rigs lnga lhun rdzogs kyi rig pa 'di/ /ye bzhugs tshul shes pas grol ba yin/ /dpe rmi lam rang ngo shes pa bzhin/ /de klong du gyur na los kyang grol/ /'di lta ba khregs chod kyi gdams pa yin/ /'od gsal lhun grub kyi sgom pa ni/ /lus mi g.yo 'od kyi khang bu na/ /rtsa dri med shel kyi sbu gu can/ /de rgyang zhags chu yi sgron mar 'brel/ /gnas rin chen rgya mtshor 'brel ba'i gdangs/ /phyi sprin bral nam mkha'i dkyil du shar/ /nang ye shes 'od lnga kha dog lnga/ /za 'og ber khyim ris su snang*/ /de thig le stong pa'i sgron mas brgyan/ /dbus rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /thig le thig phran 'brel ba ni/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser skud la/ rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan pa 'dra/ sum bsgrigs 'od kyi snang ba 'di/ /chos nyid mngon sum gyi rang snang yin/ / de gong du 'phel ba'i snang ba la/ /ye shes mkhar thabs kyi snang ba dang*/

/lnga ldan 'od kyi padma stong*/ /rtsibs rgyug rin chen dra ba dang*/ /'od lnga shel gyi mchod rten mthong*/ /thig le stong pa'i khang pa ru/ /thig pa'i sa bon yig 'bru dang*/ /rnam pa sna tshogs kyi phyag mtshan dang*/ /yongs rdzogs sku yi snang ba la/ /phyogs mtshams 'od lnga'i zer gdangs 'phro/ rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba la/ /de rnams lnga lnga zung 'brel mthong*/ /gang bltas 'od kyis 'jig rten khyab/ /snying gar zer thag zug pa mthong*/ /de tshe rang lus gcig g.yo bas/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams g.yo ba dang*/ /rang lus ting 'dzin mnyam gzhag pas/ /thams cad mnyam par 'jog pa dang*/ /sku rnams tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis/ /chos kyi rnga chen sgrogs pa dang*/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rdzogs/ /de bzhin rim gyis sa rnams kyi/ /yon tan gong du 'phel ba dang*/ /der 'dzin zad pa'i snang ba gnyis/ /mi 'gal gcig tu 'du ba ni/ /chos nyid zad pa'i sar phyin te/ /rdos bcas lus dang rtog tshogs zad/ /rnam smin las dang bag chags zad/ /ma rig 'khrul gzhi'i sa bon zad/ /snang ba rnams la 'dzin pa zad/ /rdos bcas dag pas 'phel sgo zad/ /rang lus shel gyi khang pa ru/ /'od lnga yul gyi 'phro 'du ltos/ /'od dang rig pa gar 'jug kyang*/ lhun grub ka dag ngang du thim/ /ka dag gzhi la btsan sa zin/ /nang gsal sku gsum 'du 'bral med/ /chos sku'i ngang la gzugs sku bzhugs/ /gdul bya'i 'jig rten gang yod du/ /chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos par/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i skus/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis rgyun mi 'chad/ /tshe 'dir grol ba'i gdams pa yin/ /bar do'i 'phrang la 'gro rtsa na/ /'byung ba rnams ni rim gyis thim/ /'od gsal ba la zhugs pa na/ /rang ngo shes pas gdod mar grol/ /de bzhin tshom bu ye shes dang*/ /lhun grub rang ngo shes pas grol/ /rang grol me long mthong ba yin/ / sku gsum btsan sa zin pa yin/

/sprul pa'i zhing du 'di ltar 'gro/ / shar mngon dga' mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zhing*/ /'di rang snang ston pa'i zhabs drung du/ / rang shar gyi dam chos nyan dang gcig /rang grol gyi 'dzin pa zhig dang gnyis/ /lhun grub kyi rang ngo shes dang gsum/ /gzhi rtsa chod pa'i don rtogs nas/ /lho dpal dang ldan par dbang bskur te/ /nub padma brtsegs par lung bstan nas/ /byang las rab grub par dbugs phyung ste/ /gdod ma'i ngang du rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bzhes dga' 'o skyid do rdo rje'i spun/ /nang 'od lnga'i 'gro ldog shes pa yis/ /phyi 'od gsal gyi nyi zla rgyun du 'char/ /nang rtogs pa'i gzhi rtsa chod pa yis/ /phyi rkyen ngan bde chen gyi grogs su 'char/ /nang dngas ma'i thig le'i rgyas pa yis/ /phyi mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung rgyun du 'du/ / nang 'od rtsa'i mdud pa grol ba yis/ /phyi gzung 'dzin gyi mdud pa rang sar grol/ /bde chen 'od gsal gyi sa la 'gro/ /'di dga' 'o skyid do rdo rje'i spun/ zhes gsungs pas mkha' 'gro rnams kyang dgyes so/ /de'i sang gnam gang la mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa rnal 'byor pho mo phal gyis mthong ngo*/ / srod la bud med skra'i lan tshar can nam mkha' khengs pa cig na re nga la gtor ma slong zer ba rnal 'byor pa 'od zer mtha' yas kyis mthong ngo*/ /de nas dar cig na phyogs thams cad nas bso sgra 'ur sgra sil chom la sogs pa thams cad kyis thos so/ /dar cig na sngar nyi shu brgyad kyi nyin par gyis snang ba'i mgron rnams byon dus tshogs gtor btang bas/ bud med mthing nag cig rnal 'byor ma zhig gi spyi bo la thim pa rnal 'byor pa rin chen 'od 'phros mthong nas 'khrab bo/ rnal 'byor mas slob dpon padma/ bi ma la mtsho rgyal gsum byon pa mthong ngo*/ /de dus g.yu sgron ma dkar mo mched bdun ldem bag dang ldan pa byon nas/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ res rnal 'byor ma la thim nas/

nga rdo rje g.yu sgron ma yin nga'i gnas su gshegs par zhu zer ro/ / bla mas nga khyod kyi gnas su rgyun du sdod dgos gsungs pas/ rgyun du bzhugs na dang dga' ste dgun stod tsam las mi bzhugs pa 'dug zer ro/ khyed nga la 'go ba ci yin dris pas/ gu rus dam la btags nas chos gter gyi phyi la 'brangs pa yin zer ro/ /chos ni pha gi na yod/ 'don mkhan ni shi/ 'dir ci byed dris pas/ chos pha gi na yod kyang don 'di na yod khyed tshe 'phos kyang skal ldan tshe ma 'phos pas 'ongs pa yin zer ro/ /bkang srung du yod dris pas/ mang po yod/ khyad par du dpal rdo rje phag mo/ srog sgrub nag mo/ gnod sbyin dmar nag /rdo rje g.yu sgron ma nga rnams yod/ lha rabs mched dgu /bstan ma bcu gnyis/ ldang lha rnams kyang yod zer ro/ khrid la mi du 'jug khrid thebs du yod dris pas/ bcu gcig yod dang po gsum gnyan pas mi gsum dang*/ bzhi dang lnga rnams rim pa bzhin chug /lhag ma dgu la bdun bdun mdzod/ lar ni 'di shin du gnyan pas sku tshe la bar chad 'ong nyan yod/ khrid thebs nyung na dga' zer ro/ /nga'i gter shog rnams e yod dris pas / sib sib nged rnams kyis yid bsgul ba yin mod zer ro/ /de nas dar cig na ngas khyed la dbu ru dngos grub byin pa i dran zer ba la/ bla mas lcog lar sgrub pa byed dus tho rangs shig mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi go zhub can zhig byon nas dbu rgyan bskon pas nyams rtogs bzang po skyes pa de lags sam dris pas/ yin zer ro/ khyed g.yu sgron ma e yin dri pas/ min min rdo rje phag mo yin ngo mi shes sam zer ro/ /'di nas thig le gtso bor bshad nas dbang gsum pa rten can du skur ba 'di ji ltar lags dris pas/ de chags can 'jug pa la dgongs pa yin/ chags bral la yid rig tsam gyis bskur ba yin zer ro/ /ngo sprod kyi skabs su rtog pa skye med du 'jog pa dang blo rtsis med du 'jog pa gang yin dris pas/

rtog pa la gnyen pos ci byed/ yai grol klong yangs chen mo'i dgongs par ngo sprod cig zer ro/ 'o na snying tig 'di bshad pa mang po 'dug pa ngas bshad ci dgos/ lung byed pa karma pa dang*/ rin chen gling pa la sogs pa 'dug pa la brjod pas/ de rnams kyis bshad pa la nged mi dga'/ lung dag rdza la yang yod de des gar chog /bdag po re yod pas de dgos pa yin mod zer ro/ rin chen gling pa'i gter rnams ci 'dra yin dris pas/ yin pa yin dag po med zer ro/ /ngas ni khyed ma bsgom na grub pa ci yin dris pas/ nga la sgom pa'i lha 'dug gam/ bzlas pa'i sngags 'dug gam/ mchod pa'i yul 'dug gam/ rnal 'byor dam tshig dang rtogs pa ldan pa kun la rgyun du yod pa mi shes sam/ khyed kyi'ang tshe rabs thams cad du nga dang 'du 'bral med pa yin zer ro/ /mchims phur sbas pa'i lha lcam gyi nor yod pa de ci 'dra zhig na 'dug dris pas/ brag lha bshos 'dra ba zhig la rtse mo med pa zhig na 'dug /da rung dus la ma bab zer ro/ /bi ma la'i gter de ji tsam na 'don dris pas/ da nas lo bco lnga na sngags pa dkar po zhig gis bton nas bsgyur te dar bar byed/ de na zab pa pod bzhi 'dug khyed rang gi lag tu yod pa 'dug zer ro/ /de nas zla ba tshes pa'i tshes gcig la rnal 'byor pa 'od zer go cha dpe len du btang nas/ lam du 'ongs dus 'ja' tshon gyi sna dpe la zug cing 'khor ba dang*/ khyad par du 'phyug po brag tu slebs pa'i mtshan mo de dang ri mo can gnyis 'ja' tshon kha dog lngas 'brel ba rnal 'byor pho mo kun gyis mthong ngo*/ /dge bshes blo rin gyi rmi lam du bud med cig na re/ khong mtha' la bzhud dgongs kyang nged mi gtong dgos par yod zer zhing 'dug pa bshad do/ /tshes dgu la dpe rnams gdan drangs te de nub skong bshags mdzad nas tshogs la rol dus/ mkha' 'gro babs nas/ bla ma dang slob ma gdams par 'dzom zer zhing gar mang po mdzad do/

/de nas tshes bcu la sngar bas kyang mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba rgya che ba rnal 'byor pho mo mang pos mthong zhing*/ bcu gcig gi nyin par sngar gyi khrid thon nas khrid mi rnying pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo rnams gyes dus ye shes mtsho rgyal rnal 'byor ma zhig la babs nas/ mkha' 'gro'i rang sgra mang po sgrogs shing srod la me mchod chen po mdzad nas/ la la la dngos grub phra mor byin nas phyogs gcig tu cang smra bar ma byed cig zer nas bzhag

/snod thams cad kha phye dngos grub 'bebs pa'i rten 'brel mdzad/ bla ma la dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams rim pas gtad nas 'gro don che zhing longs spyod phul sum tshogs pa 'ong bar 'dug gsungs so/ /dngos grub rnams bla ma'i gzim chung du bskyal nas nam langs so/ /de nas nyi ma shar dus rnal 'byor pho mo gnyis tsam phyir song dus mtshams dam par bcad de mkha' 'gro'i rang sgra sna tshogs sgrogs shing gar mdzad nas/ bcu gnyis kyi srod la chos sgo 'byed pa'i thugs dgongs mdzad dus/ ka pā la dang*/ me long dang*/ bum pas mkha' 'gro'i dbang gi brda rnams rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de dus yum mkha' ngo sprod kyis snang srid 'od snang du 'char ba'i gdams pa bstan to/ /de nub bzhi pa'i ngo sprod sngar ma 'khrungs pa bla ma'i thugs la 'khrungs so/ /de dus nam mkha'i skar ma la sogs pa 'di ci yin dris dus/ lhar bsam pa'i bla ma la sogs 'dug ces brjod pas/ kha cig snyam na rdzun du 'dug gang byas kyang chog snyam pa byung zhing*/ sgo lnga ka la de bzhin du byas te/ sgra'i skabs su dbyug pa la dril bu brgyus te sa la brdung zhing cir thos ci skad zer la 'ur shod dris pas/ la las snga ma bzhin the tshom du smras so/ /de dus bla ma rang gis gang btags pa de ltar snang bas chos thams cad gtad med du ngo sprod par go'o/ /de dus rnal 'byor mas sems shes te/ dad pa la sogs pa'i sems la zhen dus/ dga' brod bdud la phaṭa/ snyems byed bdud la phaṭa/ gnyis 'dzin bdud la phaṭa/ ces zer zhing 'ar 'ur mang po byas pas thams cad skrag cing rtab rtab tu gyur/ bla mas chos thams cad skad cig gis gza' gtad dang bral ba'i rtsal sbyong du shes te rtogs pa'i me long du mkhyen no/ / mtshan mo ye shes dbang lta stangs la sogs pa ngo sprod do/ /de bzhin du nyin mo gar byed cing mkha' 'gro'i rang sgra sgrogs pas song nyin tho rangs bla ma gzims dus/

'od gsal la thugs 'byams te yar ka dag gi snang ba/ bar longs sku'i tshom bu/ mar 'gro drug gi 'char tshul/ sgra skad sna tshogs thos pa la thugs kyis rig cing rags pa med pa'i snang ba dang*/ de'i skad cig snga ma na dran bsam rgyun chad nas/ snang ba dmar la mthing pa tsam gyi ngang la brgyal ba bzhin 'byams so/ /de nas lhun grub kyi snang ba la de bas rig pa rags par 'phros te yar ka dag /bar longs sku/ mar sprul sku'i ngang du 'byams so/ /de nas dar cig na rnal 'byor ma de 'ong ste snga ma'i de ni gdod ma'i ka dag tu nang gsal thim la ma rmugs par bzhugs pa'i ngo sprod yin no/ /brgyal ba zhes bya ste chos nyid kyi ngang du brgyal bas bslang dgos pa yin no/ /phyi ma ni phyir gsal du sprul sku 'gyed tshul dang*/ 'khrul pa rim gyis snang tshul rags par shar ba'i ngo sprod yin gsungs so/ /de nas nam mkha' thams cad la sngar med pa'i 'ja' tshon bka' srung so so'i gzugs 'dra ba mang po byung ba ci yin dris pas de dag yin gsungs so/ /nyi ma shar dus brda don du ma'i ngo sprad mdzad do/ /nyin gung bla ma khri la bzhugs pa la mtsho rgyal gyis gos sum brtsegs pa gsol te/ thams cad kyis yon phul phyag 'tshol de ring bu 'bogs dgos par yod zer nas/ so so nas phyag rten phul dus/ bkra shis dpag tu med pa brjod pas nam mkha' 'ja' tshon gyis khengs pa'i tshe bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzhan don rgya cher 'grub pa gdan sar bsko ba la nam mkha' 'di 'dra zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs so/ /bla ma la dngos grub re byin nas ci yin gsungs dus/ dpal 'byor rgya mtsho yin/ gzhan don lhun grub yin zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ grangs du 'dug gsungs pa la 'bum phrag grangs med 'dug ces pa la sogs pas lan btab pas 'gro don phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'byung bar 'dug gsungs so/ /phyi 'phred bla ma'i dbu la dbu rgyan gyi dod du mgron tshom lnga bzung ste dar sngon dmar gyi cod paṇa dpyangs nas bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa mang pos mnga' gsol cing*/

srod la gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i rten 'brel mdzad do/ /ngo sprod kyi rjes la mkha' 'gros 'ar 'ur mang po byung bas/ /'di 'dra chos gter gzhan 'byed pa la e yong na gsungs so/ /ngo sprod phyi ma'i nyi ma 'char khar bla mas nub ri mdun ma de'i steng gi nam mkha' la sedge'i khri dar zab kyi 'bol gdan can rgyab yol dra ba ris phra mos brgyan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ steng na rma bya'i gdugs yod pa zhig gzigs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma na re 'di slob dpon chen po rig 'dzin gyi khri yin/ khyed rang 'di la gnas pa'i brda yin/ da rung ltos shig gsungs nas bltas pas phyogs thams cad 'od lnga'i rang bzhin la/ thig les brgyan pa'i snang ba chen po gzigs pa dang*/ sku dang ye shes kyi zhing snang yin gsungs so/ / de nas bla ma nyin phyed khri la bzhugs dus mkha' 'gro snying tig gi po ti/ zhi khro'i thang ka /rdo rje sems dpa'i me long rnams dang*/ tshe'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i ka pā la phul nas gzhan rnams kyang phyag rten re 'bul du bcug ste/ phyag 'tshal shis pa mang po brjod nas gzhan don mdzad par zhu zhes rjes gnang mdzad do/ /de'i phyi dro bla ma'i gsung gis ngas khrid rim sdeb dgos gsungs nas dpe zhal phye ba dang*/ gu ru thugs sgrub kyi cha lugs su byon nas bla ma la thim pa'i g.yas na mtsho rgyal dang*/ g.yon na g.yu sgron ma khrid tshig dpod pa rnal 'byor ma zhig gis mthong ngo*/ /de dus khrid rim gnyis kyi gzhung tshan so sor phye nas tho yig tu mdzad do/ /de ltar tshes gcig nas bcu gsum gyi bar nyin zhag drug tu ye shes mtsho rgyal dngos su babs nas mkha' 'gro snying tig gi brda don dpe gsum gyi ngo sprod rdzogs par gtad rgya dang bcas pa bla ma dam pa dri med 'od zer te padma las 'brel rtsal la gnang nas o rgyan du gshegs so/ khrid kyi skabs thams cad du bla ma khri la bzhugs dus o rgyan yab yum byon nas thim par mthong dus/

dmigs pa dang ngo sprod dang brjod tshul ngo mtshar can sngar med cing yi ge na mi gsal ba mang po 'phral la rang rdol du 'byon cing gzi brjid kyang sngon pas che bar snang ngo*/ /de nas tshes bcu bzhi'i snga dro bla ma'i gsung gis de ring nas khrid 'jugs pas thams cad tshogs la mchod gtor shoms shig gsungs nas bshams te bla ma khri la byon dus nam mkha' thams cad 'jas gang dus/ rnal 'byor ma kha cig gi snang ba la/ bla ma la gu ru yab yum dang bi ma la byon nas thim pas bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur mthong*/ chos gsung dus 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad chos kyi gsung sgras khyab cing*/ mkha' 'gro sprin phung 'thibs pa tsam gyis chos nyan par mthong ngo*/ /de nas bzung ste khrid rgyab ma thon gyi bar du nyin mtshan tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ /mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba 'ja' tshon gyi snang ba dpag tu med pas khyab pa rnal 'byor pa kun gyis mthong ngo*/ /tshes bcu bzhi'i srod dbang gi sngon 'gro mdzad dus bla ma'i dbu thog na rma bya'i gdugs sum brtsegs pa gser gyi tog gis mtshan pa zhig skyes pa gos dang rgyan thams cad ser por yod pa zhig gis 'dzin cing*/ 'phan dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhan med pa mang po rang bzhin gyis 'dug pa rnal 'byor pa 'od zer mtha' yas la sogs pa 'ga'i dngos snang mthun par mthong ngo*/ /de dus mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa yang 'dus nas chos nyan no/ /bco lnga'i nyin mo thig mdzad dus thig sna gcig nas bud med dmar mo zhig gis bzung nas 'debs par snang zhing*/ do nub kyang mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba dang gdugs dang 'phan lding 'phyar ba mthong ngo*/ /bcu drug gi nyin mo bla ma gcig pus dkyil 'khor bzhengs dus bud med dar zab kyi gos can gser g.yus brgyan pa zhig gis 'bri grogs byas te phyogs bzhir dus mnyam du 'bri ba mthong ngo*/ /de dus sngon pas mgyogs shing legs par grub pas bla ma'i gsung gis/

sngon bas mkhas la mgyogs par 'dug gsungs so/ /de nub spros bcas bum dbang rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de nas sang nub dbang gong ma mdzad par dgongs nas/ sngon 'gro'i skabs su rnal 'byor pho mo bdun tshogs pas/ mkha' 'gro'i rtags glo bur ba byung ste bla ma la shangs khrag byung nas bla ma'i gsung gis/ dbang 'di la gsum las mi tshud pa la bdun 'dug khyed bzhi phyir song gsung dus/ dbang khang la 'ja' tshon sna lnga zug par mthong ngo*/ /dbang bskur dus su mkha' 'gro'i ltas dang snang ba ya mtshan can byung ngo*/ /de'i sang nyin nas khrid rgyab ma thon gyi bar du sngon chad yul de na med pa'i bya rog ya mtshan can gnyis nyin re bzhin chos kyi skabs su byung ngo*/ /spyod pa ba rnams la skyel bsu yang mdzad do/ /nyi shu dgu'i nam gung la nam gru re ma ti babs nas/ nga la gtor ma mi ster ba e yin ngas dka' las yun ring byas pa la zer dus thams cad skyi zing zing byed cing su yin dris pas/ nga tshos kun na yod/ gtsug tor tshun chad na yod pa la zer ro/ /yang dris pas/ nga nam gru re ma ti yin khyed kyi gter bsrungs pas sbyangs zer ro/ /ci yod dris pas/ na bza' dang slob dpon gyi chos gos thod pa dang bcas pa yod do/ /gtod snyam nas yong pa yin/ /ngas sngar khyed la cho 'phrul tsam bstan yang nga ngo ma shes/ kha sang nas thams cad la gtor tshogs bzang po byin nas/ nga la med pas nga kha skyengs nas thams cad 'phrog tu bcug pa yin zer dus zhud chen po byung ngo*/ khyed du yod dris pas nged lnga yod zer/ sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dris pas/ nga nam gru ri ma ti nag mo dril rta rkang bzhi zhon pa g.yas ral gri g.yon nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ma dmar mo drel rta rkang gsum chibs pa dang*/ rdo rje phra med ma ljang gu dred mo lag pa g.yob pa la zhon pa dang*/ rdo rje dbang phyug ma ser mo drel rta rkang gsum pa dang*/

/rdo rje las sgron ma dkar mo drel rta rkang gsum dang*/ de thams cad phyag mtshan bhandha dang phur pa thogs pa la/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ma shang lang dang nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin pa yin zer ro/ /gter gyi cho 'phrul dang 'ar 'ur mang po zhag gsum du byas so/ /de nas khregs chod kyi nub mo yang babs nas cho 'phrul ston dus bla mas gsungs pa/ nga nang 'od gsal gyi gter sgo 'byed pa la/ / brag ser ka'i gter gyis dgos pa med/ /nga gter yod kyang cho ga la med kyang chog /skal ldan yin kyang chog la min kyang chog /nga chos zad blo zad kyi rnal 'byor la/ khyed gter bsrungs kyi yus che 'tshong mi dgos/ zhes gsungs pas de rnams kyis kyang lan re byas te/ phar lan tshur lan 'ga' mdzad nas/ dus la babs pa dang 'don pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad pas dga'o/ /de nub o rgyan yab yum mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba byon nas byin gyis brlabs te snga ma la thim pa mthong ngo*/ /snga ma'i dbang gi skabs su yang de 'dra ba mthong ngo*/ /sang nyin thod rgal ngo sprod dus snga dro'i dro bar kha na nam mkha'i shar nub la mthing shun gyi snam bu brkyang pa lta bu'i snang ba nam mkha' dwangs pa'i kha dog dang mi 'dra ba rgyang grags phyed tsam gyi zhing yod pas thad ka'i nam mkha' chod dus bla ma'i zhal nas/ 'od mthing ga khyab pa chen pos 'od bya ba 'di 'dra zhig 'ongs pa yin gsungs dus/ byang shar du 'ja' tshon sngon dang mi 'dra ba'i kha dog lnga ldan shar bas/ 'o nang dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma 'di 'dra zhig 'ongs pa yin/ 'di na phar ltos dang*/ thig le stong pa'i sgron ma rang bzhin gyis 'char ba yin gsung dus/ nam mkha' yang sprin gcig tsam yang med par dwangs la byang du dud kha'i snang ba ya mtshan can dang*/ byang shar du lnga ldan dang*/ thad kar mthing ga'i snang ba ya mtshan can mthong dus thod rgal ngo sprod mdzad pas/ mkha' 'gro'i snang ba dang*/

ltas mang po yang sngon bas lhag par mthong ngo*/ de nub rgyab chos dang rin po che gsang ba'i ngo sprod pas ye shes mtsho rgyal bum pa bsnams nas dbang bskur ba rnal 'byor mas mthong nas/ thams cad la 'ur langs phyag 'tshol zer ro/ de nas sang gnang nyin bar do ngo sprod mdzad dus/ 'od gsal sbubs 'jug 'pho ba'i ngo sprod mdzad pas/ mkha' 'gro du ma dgyes dus/ bla ma'i gsung gis/ nga'i chos 'di la mi bas mi ma yin gtsigs che bar 'dug /don gnyer dang 'dun pa che khyed rang tsho sems la zhogs gsungs so/ /sang nyin khrid kyi skabs su ye shes mtsho rgyal nyi ma'i phyogs nas ḍā dril dkrol zhing bla ma'i sku la thim pa rnal 'byor pa 'od zer mtha' yas la sogs pa 'gas mthun snang du mthong ngo*/ /tshes bcu drug gi nub mo 'od gsal ye shes kyi ngo sprod mdzad pas/ mtha' skor dang bar snang thams cad mkha' 'gros 'khrigs te thal mo sbyar ba mthong ngo*/ /de nas tshes bcu bdun gyi nyi ma nub dus glo bur du bla ma'i gsung gis/ tshogs gtor bzang du shoms/ do nub mkha' 'gro don gyi dbang byed gsung nas mdzad dus/ sngags srung babs nas gar mdzad do/ /bla mas nged mkha' 'gro snying tig de bzhin ston pa yin/ khyed bka' srung dang mkha' 'gro rnams e dga' gsungs pas/ thugs la btags/ gu ru dang ye shes mtsho rgyal de bzhin gsung gzhan ga na yod ngo mtshar che/ sbyir mkha' 'gro thams cad dga'/ o rgyan rdzong na mkha' 'gro ma zhig lhag par gsol ba 'debs shing mnyes nas gda' zer ro/ /de nas dar cig na skyes bu chen po babs te/ do nub las dag dam tshig gtsang bas yong*/ khyed kyi gdul bya nyi ma lho nub mtshams na yod zer ro/ /ga na yod dris pas/ 'di nas nyi ma gsum tsam phyin pa na snye'i phyogs kyi ri la gu ru'i bzhugs gnas o rgyan rdzong bya ba'i brag phug che ba mkha' 'gro rang bzhin gyis 'du zhing de na rgyun du mkha' 'gro mang po rang bzhin gyis gnas pa yod/

de khyed kyis bzhugs gnas yin/ chos dang 'gro don shin tu 'phel/ der gshegs par zhu zer ro/ /'o na nga la slob ma 'gro don byed pa du yod dris pas sum cu 'ongs/ de'i nang nas sems can du ma la phan pa bcu gcig 'ongs/ khyad par can dgu 'ongs zer nas dar cig na khyed tsho bla ma 'di 'dra dang 'phrad pa 'tshengs pa yin zer dus/ thams cad kyis thos par mkha' 'gro'i rang sgra de ri ri ba dang*/ sil chom dang 'ur chom mang po byung ngo*/ /tshes brgyad kyi phyi dro chos skyong gi gtad rgya byed dus/ srog sgrub mas nga'i sgrub thabs mi klog pa zhu zer ba rnal 'byor ma zhig gis thos so/ /de nas dar cig na nyi ma nub dus bla ma'i gsung gis/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dbang khrid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas do nub gzob cig / gsung dus chang mi gda' zhus pas/ kha sing nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dngos grub byin pa yin/ do nub mkha' 'gro bos kyang e yong blta'o sbang rdza la chu rgyob la tshogs shig ngas byin gyis brlab bo gsung nas/ de bzhin btsags pas rdza ma gcig gang byung*/ des chog las che zhus pas/ do nub tsam dgos byed pa yin mi 'dang na tshogs shigs gsungs nas btsags pas thams cad chang rgod btsags pa ltar byung nas rnal 'byor pho mo thams cad bzi ba byung dus/ nga dngos pos sprul bsgyur byed pa bya ba yin gsungs nas ku re yang mdzad do/ /de dus g.yu sgron mas nga'i gnas su gshegs par zhu zer nas byung ba la zhal bzhes mdzad pas dga' nas sngon la 'gro bar zhu zer nas song dus/ sngags srung babs nas bzhud dus thugs dkrugs pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug zer ro/ /de nas dar cig na nam gru ma babs te mi bzhud par zhu zer dus/ bla mas khyed mi ma yin rnams la ngas zab chos de 'dra bshad kyang go ba mi 'dug

/dga' mi dga' blo'i cho 'phrul yin mod/ nga yod sar shog zer nas ma gnang bar/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur zhig mdzad pas ngo mtshar che thugs la btags zer ro/ khar sang nas gar phyin dris pas/ 'brog tu phud cig sdud du phyin zer ro/ /de dus phyugs nad mang po byung 'dug go /de nas rnal 'byor pho mo rnams kyis rang rang gi gos dang*/ rgyan dang rin po che la sogs pa'i maṇḍal phul/ sgrub pa'i dam bca' byas pas/ bla ma'i gsungs gis nga'i chos 'di la gtong phod che zhing sgrub pa la brtson pa mang po 'byung bar 'dug gsungs nas dgyes te 'od gsal sbubs 'jug gi gdams pa shin tu zab pa zhig gsungs so/ /de dus nga'i gdams pa 'di 'dra 'dzam bu gling na dkon pas 'od lus myur tu 'grub pa yod gsungs so/ /de nas tshes bcu gsum la dbang gong ma mdzad dus/ sngar gyi slob ma khams pa zhig gis mi rigs pa'i spyod pas thugs dkrugs dus/ chos 'di la slob ma dam nyams re yong bar 'dug gsungs nas skong bshags cig mdzad de gshegs so/ /'gro khar thugs dkrugs pa zhig 'ongs zer ba de yin par gda'o/ /de nas 'ongs pa'i lam kha 'phyug po brag tu tshogs mdzad dus 'ja' tshon mang po byung zhing mkha' 'gro'i ltas mang po yang byung ngo*/ /de nas gshegs pa'i lam du sprin med pa'i nyi ma tsha bas gdungs pa na/ gsol 'debs mdzad pas glau bur du sprin 'dus rlung rab tu mi che ba langs te g.yu sgron mas bsu ba'i snang ba yang byung ste/ mchil mor tshogs mdzad pas mkha' 'gro'i ltas du ma yang byung ngo*/ /de nas shug gseb tu gdan drangs dus/ rnal 'byor ma zhig la mkha' 'gro babs nas zhag drug tu mkha' 'gro'i rang sgra sgrogs shing bla ma o rgyan du gshegs par zhu zer ro// de dus su 'ja' tshon rgyun ma chad par nyin re bzhin byung ngo*/ /de nas gangs ri thod dkar du ri khrod btab nas o rgyan rdzong du btags te bzhugs shing*/

dbang khrid gdams pa dang bcas pa mdzad dus su'ang mkha' 'gro glo bur du babs shing ltas mang po dang nam mkha' 'jas khengs shing*/ gzim khang dang nam mkha' 'ja' tshon lnga ldan gyis 'brel ba skabs su byung ba kun gyis mthong ngo*/ /de nas dbang khrid rnams grub rting rnal 'byor pa 'od zer go chas sngar gyi mkha' 'gro snying tig gi gdams pa rnams la dbang khrid ngo sprod la sogs pa'i yig cha mdzad par zhus te/ tshogs gtor gyi sbyin bdag byas te/ ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad nas sku mtshams mdzad cing*/ bcu nas yig cha'i dbu btsugs pas/ nam mkha' 'jas khengs shing mkha' 'gro'i rnam 'gyur dang*/ gzims lam du gsol ba 'debs pa'i bud med dang*/ skyes pa'i tshogs mang pos phyag 'tshal bskor ba byed cing*/ thugs la btags thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zer ba byung zhing mtshan mo phyogs thams cad du mkha' 'gro'i rang sgra mang po dang*/ nye 'khor gyi sgom chen pa rnams la'ang cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs pa sngar med pa du ma byung ngo*/ /de ltar zla ba dang po dang*/ ston zla gnyis pa'i bar du nyin mtshan du bla ma mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs shing yig cha mdzad dus/ gzhan la phan thogs pa'i rten 'brel dang gzims lam dang*/ nyams snang dpag tu med pa dang*/ nyin re bzhin gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul gzim chung gi steng du 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba dang*/ 'od kyi snang ba ya mtshan can mang po byung ngo*/ /de nas ston gyi zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig la yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'i dga' ston mdzad nas/ rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyis bkra shis brjod dus nam mkha' 'jas khengs te bkra shis pa'i rtags bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo*/ /de 'dra'i bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi rje/ /gu ru'i thugs sras dri med 'od zer ni/ /gang dang gang du bzhugs pa de dang der/ /rang bzhin mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba rgyun mi chad/ /bkra shis dge mtshan du mas rab brgyan cing*/

/'gro ba'i don gnyis mdzad la nor bu bzhin/ /sngon rabs dus nas thugs rje'i rlabs che bas/ /mgon du mdzad pa de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma la gus gtsug gi nor bu bzhin/ /bdog pa kun gyis rtag tu mchod mdzad cing*/ /gang la'ang ma chags dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig /gza' gtad bral ba'i spyod la dgyes mdzad pa/ /'gro ba'i lam ston de la gus phyag 'tshal/ / rtag tu zhi la yang dag rab gzhol bas/ /rnam g.yeng mi mang spros pa kun las 'das/ /gzhan yang de la sbyor bas legs bskul bas/ /ting 'dzin glang po de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gong du 'od gsal chu zla stong pa'i ngang*/ / rang yang bzhugs nas 'gro ba 'god par mdzad/ /nyon mongs rtag zhi dben pa'i ri ngogs su/ /drang srong spyod pa kun gyi legs gnas pa'i/ /'phags pa'i brtul zhugs nor bdun gtsor mdzad pa/ /zhi ba'i mdzod brnyes de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /shes bya'i skar tshogs thugs la rab bkra bas/ /ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa rnam par dag /tshig don sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro 'dul ba/ /mkhas pa'i bla ma de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rang gzhan gzhungalugs rgya mtsho'i snying po las/ /zab mo'i de nyid gzigs pa mtha' yas pas/ /nges don rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gtsor mdzad pa/ /gsang sngags sdong po de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /sku tshe snga ma'i snga mar legs sbyangs pas/ / phal cher thos pas don rnams thugs su chud/ /rang byung padma'i dgongs gter rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag de la gus phyag 'tshal/ / 'di yi gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che bas/ /thar par 'gro ba'i shing rta rin chen mchog /rdo rje snying po'i theg pa gsal mdzad pa/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du 'gro sgrol ba'i/ /thugs rje mnga' ba de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /ji snyed mkhyen kyang da dung legs bshad 'tshol/ /sgom las 'das kyang da dung dben par dgyes/ /nyon mongs brgal yang da dung bag med 'jom/ /rgya mtsho ltar zab de la gus phyag 'tshal/

/lta ba'i rang bzhin nam mkha' yangs pa la/ / sgom pa'i nyi zla rang bzhin 'od gsal bas/ /spyod pa'i 'od stong 'gyed la klong yangs pa/ /dri med 'od zer de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /snga rabs goms pa'i byin rlabs pad rdzing las/ /skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs rnams dga' mdzad cing*/ /dam chos bdud rtsis 'gro kun tshims mdzad pa/ /padma las 'brel rtsal la gus phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin dpag yas gting mtha' med/ /mtha' grol ye babs gzhi rdzogs chen po'i ngang*/ /dus gsum dus bzhi dus rnams rgyun chad med/ /klong chen rab 'byams de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /'di yi ma chags gtong ba'i khyad par can/ /chos chen char gyis 'gro ba bsil mdzad gnyis/ /phan tshun 'gran la rab tu zhugs pa'i tshe/ / 'jig rten chos brgyad rtsad nas bton par 'gyur/ /gang la mi rtog ting 'dzin gru chen dang*/ /chos rnams rab 'byed shes rab kha lo sgyur/ /dus dang mthun pa'i ba dan rab g.yo bas/ /thar pa'i skams sar 'gro ba 'dren la brtson/ /dge legs thugs rje'i sprin phung 'khrigs pa las/ byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char chen rab 'babs pas/ /dad brgya'i pad mtsho ngang gis gang gyur cing*/ /phun tshogs lo tog rgyas la mngon sum gyur/ /de 'dra'i mtshungs med chos rje nyi ma ni/ /dri med tshul khrims padma lta bu ste/ /'od zer blo gros bzang po'i las 'brel rtsal/ /mtshan gsum don mthun gyur la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rang gzhan kun gyi don gnyis phun tshogs shing*/ /bde legs kun gyi 'byung gnas 'gro ba'i gnyen/ /dam chos kun gyi ye shes bang mdzod ni/ /dus rnams kun tu skye dgu'i bla mar shog /dad brgya'i chu 'dzin phyogs kyi mthar khyab pas/ /snyan pa'-i bstod dbyangs sprin gyi rnga sgra can/ /dge legs glog phreng bro gar byed pa yis/ /phan bde'i char chen 'bebs te bsngags par shog /bsod nams ston ka'i ri bong 'dzin gzugs can/

/ phun tshogs rgyu skar phreng ba'i dbus na mdzes/ /dge tshogs 'od dkar du ma'i snang ba yis/ /zab gter kunda phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /'di 'dra'i babs tshul ngo mtshar rmad byung gang*/ /skal bzang du ma'i dbang dang bcas pa zhig /dngos su byung yang deng sang dus snyigs pas/ /bdud rigs skye bo'i sgro skur gnas su 'gyur/ /de bas 'di nyid rab tu gsang bar bya/ snying dang 'dra ba gcig la gtod na yang*/ /ma spel dam tshigs bka' srung dpang tshugs shig /chig brgyud bstan la yid ches bskyed phyir gzhag /tshul 'di gangs ri thod dkar o rgyan rdzong*/ /'phags pa'i ri ngogs mdzes shing nyams dga' bar/ /phyi rabs skal ldan spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /legs sbyar me tog 'bras bu legs smin pas/ /skal ldan bung ba rab tu dga' bar mdzod/ /mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi drwa ba zhes bya ba/ dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis snang bar byas pa'i rnal 'byor pa padma las 'brel rtsal gyis zab gter mngon par 'byung ba'i lo rgyus cha tsam zhig mdor bsdus te rnam par bkod pa 'di re zhig rdzogs so// //'di rab tu gsang ba'i nan tan du bya'o/ /dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/ -PAGE 176--PAGE 175--PAGE 155-
